acceptance_criteria: A fresh specsync init writes 6.0.0 to .specsync/version; examples/quickstart passes specsync check --strict --require-coverage 100 from its own root and reports an added undocumented export; the [6.0.0] release notes no longer claim check prints an active-change count or that a post-merge binding job exists
